paper.title: ROCKET: Exceptionally Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification Using Random Convolutional Kernels

claim.method: ROCKET with 10,000 random convolutional kernels and RidgeClassifierCV
claim.split: the fixed UCR train/test split (100 train, 100 test)
claim.preprocessing: the UCR ECG200 text-format split is loaded directly; ROCKET creates 10,000 random convolutional kernels per run
claim.seedPolicy: 10 independent runs with different random kernels; no fixed seeds are stated

adapter.why: The upstream multi-dataset script fails when its dataset-name file contains one row because NumPy returns a scalar. This reviewed adapter selects ECG200 explicitly while importing the pinned repository's ROCKET transform.
adapter.source: Project-owned single-dataset form of the loop in code/reproduce_experiments_ucr.py; it imports code/rocket_functions.py from the pinned repository and writes the 10-run aggregate and per-run accuracies to JSON.
differences: project-owned adapter, not official repository code
selects ECG200 directly instead of reading a multi-row dataset-name file
writes per-run accuracy, mean accuracy, and population standard deviation to a JSON artifact
records runtime and input hashes; these additions do not alter the algorithm, split, kernels, classifier, or metric
